rules.name: Engine must not import from services
rules.description: Scientific engine must not depend on services layer.
rules.rationale: INV-016: Engine may not import from services.

rules.name: Engine must not import from database
rules.description: Engine must not depend directly on database layer.
rules.rationale: INV-002: Engine never depends on database.
rules.note: FIXED in ECO-04 — PersistencePort abstraction at engine/ports/persistence.py isolates engine from database

rules.name: Engine must not import from frontend
rules.rationale: INV-003: Engine never depends on frontend.

rules.name: Engine must not import from auth
rules.description: Auth concerns belong in services layer.

rules.name: Engine must not import from payment
rules.description: Payment must not leak into engine.

rules.name: Engine must not import from blockchain
rules.description: Blockchain must not be in engine.

rules.name: AI services must not import engine internals
rules.description: AI layer must not import deep engine implementation internals.
rules.rationale: AI isolation: AI interprets results but must not influence computation.

rules.name: Services must not import engine internals
rules.description: Services must route through EngineGateway, not import engine.hydroma, engine.cpp_core, or engine.ports directly.
rules.rationale: INV-003: Services must use Gateway — no direct engine internals import.
rules.note: ADDED in ECO-04.1 — this rule was MISSING from original 7-rule scan, causing Report 19 to incorrectly claim 0 violations

note: This report was corrected during ECO-04.1. The original Report 03 showed 7 violations and 7 rules.
